description: Prepare authorized base64 supplied visual or audio media (max100MiB/10min) using native ffprobe/ffmpeg. Audio accepts OGG/Opus, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC; preserves private original and returns validated MP3 URL, audio/mpeg MIME, duration and empty poster_url. Visual media retains its existing web/poster output. No arbitrary path/URL fetch, no publication. FFmpeg must already be installed.
name: online_media_prepare
